class.name: EditorViewportChromeRegistration
class.brief_description: Represents controls registered in editor viewport chrome slots.
class.description: Returned by [method EditorPlugin.add_control_to_viewport_chrome]. The registration creates one control for every matching editor view and removes those controls when it is unregistered. This class cannot be instantiated directly. The [EditorPlugin] that created it retains the registration until [method EditorPlugin.remove_control_from_viewport_chrome] is called or the plugin is destroyed.

method.name: is_registered
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the registration is active.

method.name: unregister
method.description: Removes and frees every control created by this registration. Calling this method more than once has no effect. Prefer [method EditorPlugin.remove_control_from_viewport_chrome] when the owning plugin is still available, so it can also discard its reference to this registration.
